name: Fish Fingers
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 1, line cook 1, poissonier 1

Flavor Profiles salty, temperature, umami, or texture
Additional Ingredients salty, sour, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 day/level; Serving Size 2d6

DESCRIPTION

Fish fingers are pressed fish coated with batter and baked or fried. Inns sometimes serve them with fries.

When completed, each serving of fish fingers can be used as ammunition for a blowgun or sling. Three servings can be consumed as one meal per day.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1d6 each.

Additional salty ingredients allow you to deal electricity damage when you attack with a fish finger using a blowgun or sling.

Additional sour ingredients allow you to deal acid damage when you attack with a fish finger using a blowgun or sling.

Additional spicy ingredients allow you to deal fire damage when you attack with a fish finger using a blowgun or sling.

S-Class Characters: The Culinarian © 2023, Samurai Sheepdog; Author: Kevin Glusing.
